## Windows update recovery

Clipthrough 0.18.0 uses stable Velopack 1.2.0. If an update fails while replacing the current application directory, the updater can leave the installation unable to start and does not automatically restore the previous directory. This is the accepted Velopack 1.2.0 limitation described in [velopack/velopack#1086](https://github.com/velopack/velopack/issues/1086); the fix is [velopack/velopack#1087](https://github.com/velopack/velopack/pull/1087), shipped in the upstream 1.3.39-g8d2844f prerelease, not in this release.

Before running Setup to recover, close Clipthrough if it is running and copy the following to a safe location outside the installation and data directories:

- `settings.json`, `storage.json`, `window.json`, `copilot-token.bin`, and the `logs` folder from the app-data root. The default root is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Clipthrough`; a custom data root may be elsewhere.
- The complete library database at the path recorded in `storage.json`, including any `-wal` or `-shm` sidecar files. The default database is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ClipthroughData\clipthrough.db`.

For an installed deployment, run the Setup installer from this release, restore the saved files to their original paths, and start Clipthrough. Verify that `storage.json` still points to the intended library and that the expected clips are present before resuming use. Setup repair can remove the app-data files when they are inside the installation root; it can also remove the library database when that database is inside the installation root.

For a portable deployment, back up the same files, overlay this release's Portable ZIP on the existing app directory, keep the `.portable` marker and `portable.flag`, then restore the saved files and verify the library and configuration before resuming use.

The Windows qualification reproduced the 1.2.0 failure with isolated synthetic libraries. It verified that separately saved copies restored the configuration and database byte-for-byte, the app started, and the seeded records were readable. In the simulated default layout, Setup removed the app-data files while the sibling default database remained unchanged; in the portable overlay fixture, the files remained unchanged. This qualification does not verify a user's actual library or Copilot sign-in state.

A future Clipthrough release is intended to adopt a stable Velopack version containing the upstream fix, so that release's own updater package includes protection for subsequent updates.
